calculator_engine: function termInsurance(income,age,retAge,assets,expenses){const yearsLeft=retAge-age;const multiplier=age<=30?20:age<=40?15:10;const incomeMethod=income*multiplier;const expenseMethod=expenses*25;const hlv=income*(yearsLeft*0.7);const recommended=Math.max(incomeMethod,expenseMethod,hlv)-assets;return{incomeMethod,expenseMethod,hlv,recommended:Math.max(0,recommended)};}
